name: Shimizu Arata
source:
Shimizu is a poor boy who spends all day and night working parttime jobs. He lives alone in an apartment away from his family, who have their own financial problems regarding taking out loans they couldn't pay back. He has a general hatred of rich people.

Seiyuu: Hashiguchi Daisuke.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/oreshita/oreshita.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
